For three years Char'li remained at the Great Tree studying the works of the Shamans and tending to the garden of the Flora, his mind and body growing strong as he advanced from his youth into his prime. Many of his kin had begun to follow in his footsteps, seeking out the Great Tree to study to the works of the Shamans and advance their learning having thrived within the fledgling schools established within The Grove. The arrival of these students pleased Char'li though they filled him with a longing for home, Sha'ne had not recovered as quickly as Char'li had and was still spending much of her time bedbound when the fire had set him on his path. Often he mind would drift to thoughts of home but his place was with the Flora and the Brotherhood until his training was complete.

Char'li's fate once again found itself at the whim of the Gods when Phyra, God of Order, seeking to scour chaos from the surface of Gaea sent forth his army of sentinels. One segment of the metallic horde swept into the southern forest in the pursuit of the races most despised by their master seeking to claim the Flora. Char'li, along with all who had been awaiting the arrival of the Chlora was caught by surprise, tossed aside along with his Shaman and soldier brethren. Thought their salvation had come with the awakening of Hom the rout had troubled Char'li deeply. The training had been fruitful, there was no denying that, where once the life force of his brethren had been a crushing weight it now flowed around him like an ocean of light, allowing him to experience the totality or to focus in on an individual. So too were emotions revealed to him if he was willing to focus on an individual though he used this ability seldom as strong emotions could at times become overpowering. Yet for all his advancements he had yet to display the kind of power shown by the Chieftain. Char'li was indeed grateful for all the Flora had done but in his heart he had come to believe that his power should be used to protect both Flora and Med'ja and he had been powerless against the Sentinels. Neither the Flora nor the Shamans of Umbralocht understood the Magic that coursed through his veins and Se'Kin and the Chieftain were long dead. Determined to unlock greater powers Char'li knew that his time at the Great Tree had come to an end.

Bidding farewell to his teachers Char'li set forth for the Grove of Hom. He had no idea where his journey would take him but he knew that it would begin at home.

##### Char'li's powers are now as follows:

- Sense life: Char'li has the ability to sense any living being that has a soul. The range of this ability initially extended to 50 metres however as a result of his training this ability now extends out to 500m

- Sense soul: Char'li can focus in and search for a specific living soul, this ability has no range per say however he has to have met the soul so that he can recognise it and depending on how far they are from him depends on how draining the ability is

- Empathy: Char'li can sense the emotions of nearby souls that he can focus in on,

- Mental projection: Char'li can project emotions/ single word commands to a single target but he has not practiced this much so the effectiveness varies. range is restricted to the range of Sense soul.

- Spell Shatter: this ability which only activates in high stress situations can dispel any illusion or spell placed over Char'li and his companions but is very draining and cannot be controlled as Char'li does not even know he possesses the ability.
